name: Bussho Saji
source:
When Bussho teaches yoga, he does not merely guide his students through a set of physical exercises; he resolves to reshape their outlook on reality itself. His unusual musings about the nature of delusion have garnered an audience of intellectuals seeking profound self-understanding and mental well-being. Bussho's most prized teachings are kept confidential, bestowed only to those who have devoted themselves to his doctrine for years. In the past, the misuse of his wisdom by uninformed minds sparked turmoil, resulting in the dissolution of several marriages and a series of disturbing social media posts - testaments to both the hubris of man and the complexity of his philosophy.

Bussho's yoga sessions aim to serve as an accessible alternative to conventional professionals. It was no surprise to anyone when Bussho was accepted into Bitokukawa Academy - a man of his temperament and insight, who guided thousands in his quest for a greater truth, deserves to be called Ultimate.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/danganronpa/comments/1ecqq0w/meet_bussho_the_former_ultimate_yoga_guru/]bio[/url]]
